notes: This instruction manual contains no Modbus register map, communication data addresses (S/M codes) or parameter-to-register addressing rule; only the y-code RS-485 settings (page_index 96, printed 5-19) are documented. Other pages refer to the separate "RS-485 Communication User's Manual" for communication details, so modbus_registers is empty.

Default values with letters denote shipping destination: A (Asia), C (China), E (Europe), U (USA) (note on printed page 5-3 and others). Values "See Table A." refer to Table A Fuji Standard Motor Parameters (page_index 97, printed 5-20), which lists per-model values (e.g. FRN0004C2S-4: torque boost 6.8 %, rated capacity 0.75 kW).

setting_conditions holds the "Change when running" column as printed: Y = possible, Y* = possible ("the change will immediately take effect; however, the change is not saved into the inverter's memory" until saved with the keypad), N = impossible (page_index 78, printed 5-1).

The manual does not define a separate rated motor voltage or rated motor frequency parameter; F05 (Rated Voltage at Base Frequency 1) and F04 (Base Frequency 1) are the closest documented codes. Motor 2 equivalents exist in A codes (A01-A26) but were not extracted.
